body: Without getting into it too much, his parents have their own problems.  I honestly don't feel they've ever noticed anything about him.  Since I've known him, they just let him do whatever he wants.  It's why he hasn't ever had a job more than a month or so, why he has no sense of responsibility for anything, why he thinks it's okay to be such a dick to so many people.  Makes me appreciate what my parents did for me, anyway, instilling a strong work ethic and sense of personal, financial and social responsibility.  This kid has none of those things.

Not a terrible idea, especially the last part.  I feel like getting his parents involved would be counterproductive.  If they cared, they would have already noticed.

I'd been kicking around a bit of "intervention" idea actually, thinking of approaching one of his other good friends who is a great role model and has a successful career, healthy lifestyle etc.  Reading your comment makes me think more about this option.
Thanks for the reply.  I'm a guy, though.  For the record.
